critique: The white-on-black particle treatment is appropriate, but the result still does not read as a Point Rise. At t4 it forms a dense, nearly stationary bright core with a small omnidirectional puff around it; compared with t1 there is no clearly legible upward stream. The cluster also appears slightly lower rather than rising. The emission needs to be aimed into screen-up motion rather than along depth, and the excessive core density should be reduced so separate ascending points remain visible.

suggestions.why: Rotate the directional emitter into the screen-up axis so the t1-to-t4 motion reads as a clearly rising point stream instead of a depth-facing radial puff.
Reduce the continuously replenished center density, preventing the stationary bright core from obscuring the individual upward-moving particles.
